_about: Adventist words for live translation. Edit freely; the translator reloads this file when it starts. 'prompt' steers the Afrikaans recognition towards these spellings. 'terms' replace an Afrikaans phrase with fixed English before translating (longest first, whole words, any capitalisation). 'fixes' correct the English afterwards.
